stories.title: MLB trade deadline winners and losers: What we loved -- and don't understand
stories.summary: The 2026 trade deadline has passed. Here's who hit it out the park -- and who swung and missed.

stories.title: MLB trade grades: Red Sox add Rutschman, Cubs get Holmes from Mets
stories.summary: Our running scorecard for every big move before Monday's deadline.

stories.title: Orioles ship out All-Star C Rutschman to Red Sox
stories.summary: The Red Sox have acquired three-time All-Star catcher Adley Rutschman in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, the biggest in a slew of deadline moves for Boston.

stories.title: Injury-depleted Cubs acquire Holmes from Mets
stories.summary: The Cubs acquired right-hander Clay Holmes and outfielder Tyrone Taylor from the Mets for infielder Jefferson Rojas on Monday.

stories.title: Padres trade for Ray, Mize to help rotation woes
stories.summary: The Padres shored up their starting rotation at the trade deadline, acquiring left-hander Robbie Ray from the Giants and right-hander Casey Mize from the Tigers.
